interactionChecks.name: selected focus default and OFF persistence
interactionChecks.evidence: 주변 근육 흐리게 starts aria-pressed=true; after turning it off, selecting another muscle retained false and the route/card changed to that muscle.

interactionChecks.name: keyboard muscle selection and viewer rotation input
interactionChecks.evidence: ArrowLeft was sent to the focused anatomy canvas; Enter on structure-list controls selected posterior tibialis and updated the card and URL. Repeated on the built preview at 390px.

interactionChecks.name: muscle to bone to muscle
interactionChecks.evidence: A real canvas pointer click selected the right tibia and its bone card/URL; the tibia card's soleus link returned to the soleus muscle card/URL. Repeated the tibia pointer pick on the built preview.

interactionChecks.name: transparent/de-emphasized pointer access
interactionChecks.evidence: With surrounding muscles transparent, canvas pointer selection reached the right fibula. In a posterior scene with bones hidden and the anterior tibialis selected, a pointer click through faded layers selected soleus.

interactionChecks.name: isolation follows changing selection
interactionChecks.evidence: Isolation remained pressed while selecting a different muscle; the selected structure, card, route and isolation target moved together. A built-preview mobile keyboard run reproduced this.

interactionChecks.name: restore preserves base hidden state
interactionChecks.evidence: After hiding bones, isolating a muscle and using view reset, isolation cleared while the bones control remained off.

interactionChecks.name: browser history and selection clearing
interactionChecks.evidence: Back/forward restored the prior and next muscle URL and selected card. Selection clear removed the typed selection; a subsequent keyboard list selection restored the corresponding card.

interactionChecks.name: unsupported region transition
interactionChecks.evidence: Selecting head showed the explicit preparation state and did not display the calf scene; returning to leg showed the calf scene and a valid calf selection.

interactionChecks.name: learner surface labels
interactionChecks.evidence: Visible controls use learner wording; no task number, JSON, authoring tool or internal review code appeared in the learner DOM/accessibility tree.

scopeNotes: Screenshots were visually inspected in the in-app browser; this evidence file stores measured geometry and interaction outcomes, not image exports.
